Product copy: 'If you've ever spent a winter in Wisconsin (where we're headquartered)'; Expedition Parka: 100% waterproof seam-sealed shell, 600 fill power down. Willis & Geiger bomber: 'another product from our Willis & Geiger lineup' (men's outerwear page data).

10-K for fiscal 2025 (filed 2026-03-26): 'a leading digital retailer of solution-based apparel, swimwear, outerwear'; channels U.S. eCommerce, Europe eCommerce, Outfitters (uniform and logo apparel), Third Party marketplaces, Licensing, Retail ('Company Operated stores, located in the U.S.') = us_stores true; orders fulfilled to about 130 countries outside the US; HQ 5 Lands' End Lane, Dodgeville, Wisconsin; trademarks incl. Willis & Geiger, ThermaCheck, Squall (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/799288/000119312526126210/le-20260130.htm).

Wikipedia: began as a mail-order yachting supply company in 1963 in Chicago (Gary Comer and partners); HQ Dodgeville, Wisconsin; Nasdaq LE; Sears bought it in 2002 and spun it off in April 2014; 26 domestic stores as of February 2024; 2020 partnership with Kohl's to sell its products in Kohl's stores (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lands%27_End).
